selection.method: Visual identification against manuscript PNG, independently cross-checked with original GT, predictions and radar clouds.

sample_evidence.pose: Bent elbows in front of torso with a wide stance; matches Sample 1 GT/predicted limbs and target cloud.
Upright pose with arms hanging down; matches Sample 2 GT/predicted limbs and target cloud.
Raised knee with asymmetrically bent arms; matches Sample 3 GT/predicted limbs and target cloud.

excluded.reason: Upright bent-arm pose with near-straight closely spaced legs, absent from the three manuscript samples.

source.axes_evidence: Axis limits, ticks, orientation and box ratio are recorded in each panel.
source.data_policy: Frozen original predictions/GT and five input frames only. No new inference, synthetic coordinates, axis mirroring, scale fitting or temporal interpolation.
